'''Karl Schügerl''' (22 June 1927 – 20 October 2018)<ref name="Obituary">{{Cite web |url=https://trauer-anzeigen.de/traueranzeige/karlwilhelm-schuegerl/anzeigen |title=Traueranzeigen von Karl Wilhelm Schügerl |website=trauer-anzeigen.de |language=de-DE |access-date=2019-10-13}}</ref> was a Hungarian-German chemical engineer. He was a member of the [[Hungarian Academy of Sciences]].<ref>Stoyan Tzonkov, [http://www.clbme.bas.bg/old_ba/anniversary_7.pdf The 80th Birthday of Professor Karl Schügerl] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110706142759/http://www.clbme.bas.bg/old_ba/anniversary_7.pdf |date=2011-07-06 }}, ''Bioautomation'', vol. 7, 2007.</ref><ref>[http://www.mta.hu/index.php?id=members&LANG=e&TID=670&cHash=947675a292 Member bio page.] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20091203233044/http://www.mta.hu/index.php?id=members |date=2009-12-03 }} [[Hungarian Academy of Sciences]]. Accessed December 2, 2009</ref> He also was awarded an honorary doctorate by the [[Budapest University]].<ref name="65th" /> In 1992 vol. 46 of the [[Springer Verlag|Springer]] book series ''Advances in Biochemical Engineering/Biotechnology'' was dedicated to Karl Schügerl's 65-th birthday.<ref name="65th">A. Fiechter. [https://doi.org/10.1007%2FBFb0000702 Foreword: To Professor Dr. Karl Schügerl on his 65th Birthday.] Modern Biochemical Engineering. Advances in Biochemical Engineering/Biotechnology, vol. 46, 1992, pp. vii-ix</ref> Schügerl was awarded the [[DECHEMA|DECHEMA Medal]] in 1997.<ref>[http://www.dechema.de/Preisträger_DECHEMA_Medaille.html List of DECHEMA Medal recipients] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140729093111/http://www.dechema.de/Preistr%C3%A4ger_DECHEMA_Medaille.html |date=2014-07-29 }}, DECHEMA. Accessed November 30, 2009.</ref>
